product.description: fully recessed step light for a vertical face near the ground, down-lighting position only: three integrated LEDs behind a diffusing polycarbonate lens and the RB faceplate, warm 2700 K, bronze metallic finish, 12 V
product.codeBasis: the ordering code: fixture RH, power 3LED, colour temperature W (warm, 2700 K), faceplate RB, finish BZ (bronze metallic)

light.beamName: diffused downward for glare-free safety lighting, from a vertical face in the down-lighting position

electrical.supply: 10 to 15 V AC or DC from a remote transformer
electrical.control: phase dimmable (trailing edge); zoned and dimmed by a Luxor controller in its ZD version

housing.materials: die-cast A380 aluminium body, stainless steel fasteners, polycarbonate lens
housing.finish: bronze metallic: sulfuric acid anodising under a polyester TGIC powder coat
housing.mounting: recessed in a vertical face, down-lighting position only, into a single-gang junction box

photometricFile.note: The spec sheet's photometry gives spacing to 1.1, 3.2, 5.4 and 10.7 lx at 60 mm and 0.3 m mounting heights; an IES file is on the maker's site, whose pages refuse automated reads.

sources.title: FX Luminaire, RH Recessed Wall/Step Light, Designer Plus spec sheet (generated 20 May 2025): 3LED 86 lm at 2700 K, 4.0 W, CRI 84, maximum 49 cd; ordering information; materials

unverified: The faceplate's size: the spec sheet gives it only in a drawing whose figures were not read; the sheets ask for a face about 0.10 by 0.06.
The RB faceplate's form: the spec sheet names it RB and shows it only in a drawing; whether it is louvred, as the sheets ask, was not read.

Its distribution beyond the peak: the IES file was not read, so Light lights it as the Gaussian beam that its published flux (86 lm) and peak intensity (49 cd) fix together, about the axis it is aimed along.
